notes: Integrate Ethereum mainnet Uniswap v3 and v4 LP NFT positions with owner validation and read-only onchain principal valuation.
Compute underlying token amounts by liquidity and live tick/range and estimate v3 claimable amounts via simulated collect eth_call; compute v4 unclaimed swap fees via StateView fee growth.
Unclaimed fees and unwithdrawn principal are shown separately; v3 claimable may include withdrawn principal as explicitly labeled.
Display per-position v3/v4, in/out-of-range status, wallet tokens vs LP vs claimable, without double counting collected fees.
Use ERC721Enumerable v3 NFT discovery; for v4 use read-only public Blockscout NFT indexing with onchain ownership validation, fail closed if discovery is unavailable or incomplete.
Limit valuations to Ethereum ETH/WETH/USDT/USDC and refuse automatic wallet updates when pool tokens, prices, ownership or fees cannot be fully validated.
Server-only reads, no wallet transactions, no new Vercel functions, no DB migrations and no extra scheduled jobs.
Release pending owner approval; changes prepared in GitHub feature branch only.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
